MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
Reported regime is NEUTRAL, with normal 20-day volatility at 27.1% and narrow participation: 0/8 sectors were positive over one week. Breadth is weak despite the supplied neutral classification.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation led on a relative basis, though still negative: 1W -3.09% and 1M +17.46%, CORRECTION; THYAO (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +23.94%) is in CORRECTION. Banking & Finance and Construction & REIT also showed relative resilience, with sector 1W returns of -3.82% and -4.36%, respectively, both in CORRECTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals was weakest at 1W -8.28% and 1M -9.24%, BELOW TREND; TUPRS (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -8.02%) is in BELOW TREND. Retail & Food and Holding & Investment were also BELOW TREND, with 1W returns of -6.58% and -7.31%.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
By 1W return, TOASO (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +12.54%) is ABOVE TREND; VAKBN (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +6.42%), TKFEN (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +10.04%) and THYAO (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +23.94%) are in CORRECTION. YKBNK (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +4.19%) is also in CORRECTION.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -16.64% | 1M: -11.04%), PETKM (1W: -10.38% | 1M: -19.34%), HEKTS (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -18.03%), SOKM (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -29.86%) and ARCLK (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -13.31%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
TOASO (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +12.54%) was the only listed stock with a positive weekly return and remains ABOVE TREND. The least-negative weekly moves were VAKBN (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +6.42%), TKFEN (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +10.04%) and THYAO (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +23.94%), all in CORRECTION.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
The sector remains in CORRECTION, with a 1W average return of -3.82% against +4.74% over one month. GARAN (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +13.39%) and YKBNK (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +4.19%) are in CORRECTION; AKBNK (1W: -6.72% | 1M: +0.93%) and ISCTR (1W: -6.07% | 1M: +0.89%) are also in CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry was BELOW TREND at the sector level, with 1W -6.30% and 1M -4.28%. TOASO (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +12.54%) stands out ABOVE TREND, while FROTO (1W: -2.53% | 1M: +6.91%) is in CORRECTION and EREGL (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -13.85%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector was the weakest, down 8.28% for the week and 9.24% for the month; sector momentum is BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -8.02%), SISE (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -6.57%) and SASA (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.59%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a cautious, selectively defensive stance: zero sectors posted positive weekly returns, and all sectors were disqualified in the supplied quant rankings except Transportation. Keep exposure selective and require breadth improvement before adding broad market risk.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor THYAO (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +23.94%) and PGSUS (1W: -3.24% | 1M: +20.57%), both in CORRECTION, for a possible stabilization in the relative sector leader. TOASO (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +12.54%) remains ABOVE TREND, while TKFEN (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +10.04%) is in CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Transportation is the relative leader but remains in CORRECTION; Energy & Chemicals is the clearest laggard and remains BELOW TREND. Track Banking & Finance for a potential turn, as its sector trend is also CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 support or resistance levels were provided, so specific index levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a recovery in sector breadth from 0/8 and continued volatility near its current 27.1% reading.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The reported NEUTRAL regime masks weak participation: volatility is normal, but no sector posted a positive weekly return. Transportation and selective industrial names offer relative resilience, while energy and retail weakness argues for caution until breadth improves.
